# sim-lib-agent-runner-process

`ProcessProgram` is the structured process boundary for duplex protocols such
as MCP stdio: bounded stdin and stdout frames, a distinct bounded stderr sink,
and an explicit exit report. It accepts a complete portable `ProcessRequest`
and dispatches only through `ProcessPort`; literal `ArgAtom` values never pass
through a shell or command-string parser.
